kpis.signal: Hero KPI Fortinet, 68% du CA total, base recurring forte (FortiGuard + FortiCare). Croissance soutenue 20%/an.
kpis.description_fr: CA Service Fortinet : abonnements FortiGuard (threat intelligence) + FortiCare (support technique). Base recurring forte, pilier monétisation.
kpis.description_en: Fortinet Service revenue: FortiGuard subscriptions (threat intelligence) + FortiCare (technical support). Strong recurring base, monetization pillar.

kpis.signal: Hardware FortiGate firewalls, en plateau après cycle destocking 2023-24. Catalyseur reprise refresh corporate 2025.
kpis.description_fr: CA Produit : appliances FortiGate (firewalls hardware avec ASIC propriétaire SPU). Cyclique sur refresh corporate, plateau FY24.
kpis.description_en: Product revenue: FortiGate appliances (firewall hardware with proprietary SPU ASIC). Cyclical on corporate refresh, plateau FY24.

kpis.signal: Indicateur avancé revenus futurs (revenue + delta deferred revenue). Croissance ralentie 2024.
kpis.description_fr: Billings non-GAAP Fortinet (revenue + variation deferred revenue). Indicateur avancé pipeline revenus reconnaissables.
kpis.description_en: Fortinet non-GAAP billings (revenue + deferred revenue change). Leading indicator of pipeline revenue to recognize.

kpis.signal: FCF puissant pour financer R&D + buybacks. Conversion cash élevée modèle subscription.
kpis.description_fr: Free Cash Flow non-GAAP Fortinet. Conversion cash élevée grâce mix subscription. Financement R&D et programmes rachat actions.
kpis.description_en: Fortinet non-GAAP free cash flow. High cash conversion thanks to subscription mix. Funds R&D and share buyback programs.

kpis.signal: Marge opérationnelle en forte hausse FY24 (+690 bps), leadership rentabilité cybersécurité
kpis.description_fr: Marge opérationnelle Fortinet. 30.3% FY24 vs 23.4% FY23 (+690 bps). Leader rentabilité parmi pure-plays cybersécurité.
kpis.description_en: Fortinet operating margin. 30.3% FY24 vs 23.4% FY23 (+690 bps). Profitability leader among cybersecurity pure-plays.

_notes: FTNT = Fortinet. Pure-play cybersécurité (firewalls, SD-WAN, ZTNA, SASE). Differentiation = ASIC propriétaire SPU + plateforme convergente. Acquisitions récentes : Lacework (CNAPP), NextDLP.
